title: Words identity
description: Which card's words these are, and in which language. A print whose words differ from the base also names the print: set_code and number. The path already tells base from exception, and check-id checks the difference: base/entity/ files hold no set_code or number, and card/<set>/ files do.

lang.description: The language of these words, such as ja.

set_code.description: The official code of the product whose print shows words of its own, such as STA.

number.description: The collector number of that print, as printed; e.g. 170 or 170★.
